ac_text.AC-1: kiwi-step claims a step via claim_step before authoring any step-local requirement.
ac_text.AC-2: kiwi-step authors requirements only under docs/spec/steps/<name>/ and never writes into body-scope SRS files.
ac_text.AC-3: kiwi-step runs step-local validation via validate_step as part of its authoring workflow.

runtime_deps.claim_step: MCP tool (src/core/mutation/claim-step.ts; schemas.ts hosted on set-supersede)
runtime_deps.validate_step: MCP tool + CLI 'speckiwi step validate <name>' (src/core/validator/validate-scoped.ts; schemas.ts:202)
